description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the photo to dnd character workflow: turn an owned portrait into a fantasy roleplaying character. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_photo_to_dnd_character with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_photo_to_dnd_character.
